symbolic.name: kepler_third_law
symbolic.description: Kepler's third law for exoplanet orbital period
steps: Start from gravitational force = centripetal force: G M m / a^2 = m v^2 / a
Cancel planet mass m: G M / a = v^2
Substitute orbital velocity v = 2 pi a / P (circular orbit: circumference / period)
G M / a = 4 pi^2 a^2 / P^2
Rearrange: P^2 = 4 pi^2 a^3 / (G M)
Take square root: P = 2 pi sqrt(a^3 / (G M))

checks.label: P^2 proportional to a^3 (Kepler's third law)

symbolic.name: atmospheric_escape_energy_limited
symbolic.description: Energy-limited atmospheric escape rate (Watson et al. 1981)
symbolic.formula: dM/dt = pi * R^3 * F_XUV * epsilon / (G * M * K)
steps: XUV power absorbed by planet: P_abs = pi * R^2 * F_XUV * epsilon
(cross-section pi R^2, heating efficiency epsilon)
Gravitational potential energy per unit mass at surface: U = G M / R
Roche lobe correction reduces potential barrier: U_eff = G M K / R
(K <= 1 accounts for stellar tidal potential reducing escape energy)
Mass loss rate from energy balance: dM/dt = P_abs / U_eff
Substitute: dM/dt = (pi R^2 F_XUV epsilon) / (G M K / R)
Simplify: dM/dt = (pi * R^3 * F_XUV * epsilon) / (G * M * K)

checks.label: Formula structure identity (dM/dt = pi R^3 F_XUV eps / (G M K))
Energy balance: absorbed XUV power = gravitational power for escape

symbolic.name: stellar_density_from_transit
symbolic.description: Stellar mean density inferred from a central transit (Seager & Mallen-Ornelas 2003)
steps: Central transit (b=0), small planet: full transit duration T = 2 R_* P / (pi a)
Solve for a/R_* = 2 P / (pi T)
Substitute a/R_*: rho_* = (3 pi/(G P^2)) (2 P/(pi T))^3
Simplify: rho_* = 24 P / (pi^2 G T^3)

checks.label: rho_* simplifies to 24 P / (pi^2 G T^3)
algebraic identity of the two forms

symbolic.name: rv_semi_amplitude
steps: Newtonian two-body: separation a = (G (M*+Mp) P^2/(4 pi^2))^(1/3)
Star orbits the barycentre: a_* = a * Mp/(M*+Mp)
Projected velocity amplitude: K = 2 pi a_* sin i / (P sqrt(1-e^2))
Substitute a and simplify: K = (2 pi G/P)^(1/3) Mp sin i / (M*+Mp)^(2/3) / sqrt(1-e^2)

checks.label: K satisfies K^3 (M*+Mp)^2 (1-e^2)^(3/2) = (2 pi G/P) Mp^3

symbolic.name: kopparapu_hz_flux
symbolic.description: Kopparapu 2013/2014 HZ boundary from the S_eff(T_eff) polynomial
symbolic.formula: a (AU) = sqrt(L*/L_sun / S_eff), S_eff = s0 + a T + b T^2 + c T^3 + d T^4, T = T_eff - 5780
steps: S_eff(T_eff) polynomial (Kopparapu 2013 Table 3) for each boundary
Flux balance at the boundary: L*/(4 pi a^2) = S_eff * L_sun/(4 pi (1 AU)^2)
Solve for a: a (AU) = sqrt(L*/L_sun / S_eff)
Conservative HZ: moist_greenhouse (inner) <= S/S_earth <= max_greenhouse (outer)

checks.label: HZ distance satisfies a^2 * S_eff = L*/L_sun

symbolic.name: scale_height_hydrostatic
symbolic.description: Atmospheric scale height from hydrostatic equilibrium (ideal gas)
steps: Hydrostatic equilibrium: dp/dz = -rho g
Ideal gas: p = rho k_B T/(mu m_p)
Solution: rho(z) = rho_0 exp(-z/H) with H = k_B T/(mu m_p g)
Pressure at the base: p_0 = rho_0 g H

checks.label: Hydrostatic consistency: p = rho g H
